title: Harden iPhone touch controls and responsive mobile layout
description: Touch controls rely on touchstart/touchend and fixed-size 16:9 controls. Real iPhones can hit touchcancel, pointer loss, app switch, lock, orientation change, and safe-area overlap. Switch to Pointer Events, clear active controls on cancel/blur/visibility changes, add touch-action/user-select safeguards, and build/test an iPhone-first landscape layout.
acceptance_criteria: No stuck controls after cancel/drag-off/app-switch/orientation-change; controls respect safe-area insets; iPhone SE through Pro Max landscape smoke tests show no HUD/control overlap.
notes:
Phase 1 (commits 5da4065, af79b8c, 3526058):
- Detection switched to matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)') with change listener
- visibilitychange/blur/pagehide/orientationchange clear keysPressed + touchStateRef + analogInputRef + force-off siren/boost/engine
- TouchControls aria-labels (Accelerate / Steer L/R / Brake / RIDS / Boost / Siren+aria-pressed / Colleague assist), aria-hidden glyphs
- Safe-area insets on all four sides for TouchControls + HUD
- RotateDevicePrompt with aria-live polite + per-session sessionStorage dismiss
- index.html prefers-reduced-motion global kill-switch

Phase 2 (commits e87b199, 286959d, 6d4d937):
- Dropped isTouchDevice prop drilling Game→HUD; CSS @media(pointer:coarse) for keyboard-hint hide/show
- max-h:400 layout compressions for iPhone SE/8+ landscape
- District TS import fix; setDebugInfo gated on ?debug

Phase 3 (commits 3f18c1b, 780e7d8, e30cfc1): real-device emulation testing + landscape overlap fix
- Vite watch ignored .beads/.dolt/.gstack/.serena/.git
- Playwright iPhone-device-descriptor smoke tests across SE/8+/12/14 Pro Max + desktop
- BUG FIXED: RIDS button overlapped HUD minimap on phones with viewport height between 400 and 500 (8 Plus 414h, 14 Pro Max 430h). Widened bottom-shift breakpoint from max-h:400 to max-h:500. Verified: zero overlaps across all viewports.

Phase 4 (commits 7a71b84, a307eb0): viewport + PWA fullscreen
- iOS Safari address bar fix: layered .app-vh / .app-min-vh classes (height:100vh; height:100dvh; — older browsers ignore unknown 100dvh, modern Safari/Chrome/Firefox use it)
- PWA fullscreen meta tags: apple-mobile-web-app-capable=yes, mobile-web-app-capable=yes, status-bar-style=black-translucent, web-app-title, theme-color=#0d0221
- 'Add to Home Screen' on iOS launches game in true fullscreen (no browser chrome)

Phase 5 (commit 32c2737, 1b747b4): controller redesign
- LEFT: virtual analog joystick (128px base, 56px knob, 0.3 deadzone, role='img' + aria-roledescription='joystick' + aria-label, role='application' rejected as too aggressive). Pointer Events with setPointerCapture so finger-drag continues outside base. touch-action:none.
- RIGHT: 2x2 round Xbox-style action grid (BOOST cyan / SIREN red / RIDS yellow / ASSIST green). 64x64 buttons (>>WCAG 2.5.5 AA 44x44). touch-action:manipulation kills 300ms tap delay.
- ANALOG steering + throttle: gentle joystick push = gentle turn, hard push = sharp turn. analogInputRef carries 0..1 magnitude; driving code multiplies by it; keyboard fallback uses 1.0 full intensity.

Phase 6 (commits b689e3c, c1fb24d, 5505ada, a86e3da): procedural audio system
- utils/audio.ts: zero-asset Web Audio synthesis, AudioContext lazy on first user gesture
- click/beep/zap/thud/siren/engine/tick functions
- engine drone tied to player.speed (idle 80Hz → max 240Hz, lerped over 100ms)
- siren two-tone wail (900/650 Hz alternating)
- time-pressure ticks in final 10s with rising pitch + final-second zap
- mute toggle (gd-39w shipped): fixed top-right circular button at App level, aria-pressed + aria-label, localStorage persist, 48x48 target, focus-visible:outline-cyan-300
- Engine + siren stop on game-state-change AND component unmount AND visibilitychange/blur/pagehide/orientationchange (no oscillator leaks)

Acceptance criteria status:
- 'No stuck controls after cancel/drag-off/app-switch/orientation-change': ✓ (visibilitychange handler clears all input refs + force-stops engine/siren/boost)
- 'controls respect safe-area insets': ✓ (all four sides on TouchControls + HUD + MuteToggle)
- 'iPhone SE through Pro Max landscape smoke tests show no HUD/control overlap': ✓ via playwright iPhone device emulation; real-device hardware smoke test still recommended

Outstanding for full close (real-device test required):
- Real iPhone hardware smoke test SE → Pro Max (audio responsiveness, joystick feel, HUD legibility)
- Optional: keyboard-hint chips DOM presence for Bluetooth-keyboard-on-iPad (any-hover detection or progressive enhancement on first Tab key)
- apple-touch-icon (180x180 PNG) + manifest.json for polished PWA install (recommended follow-up)

title: Make game loop delta-time based for mobile fairness
description: The game loop advances shift time, movement, timers, deterrence, siren, and effects using fixed per-frame values. On 120Hz iPhones the game can run too fast; under throttling it can run too slow. Convert simulation updates to elapsed delta seconds, clamp large deltas, and add regression coverage for 30/60/120fps timing.
acceptance_criteria: Shift duration and representative vehicle distance are stable across 30, 60, and 120fps simulations; countdown does not consume shift time; core timers use elapsed seconds rather than frame counts.
close_reason: Closed via fix: TDZ in constants.ts DT_* per-second rates (commit d3b78cd). Delta-time loop is now functional; bundle no longer throws ReferenceError at module init. Verified live on https://staging2.esponet.me/ — game mounts, draw:true, simulated cars=49.

title: Add mute toggle for procedural audio (WCAG 1.4.2 strict reading)
description:
Per accessibility-lead review during the procedural audio shipping (commit b689e3c) and the engine drone shipping: WCAG 1.4.2 Audio Control technically requires a user-controllable mute mechanism when audio plays >3 seconds, even if user-initiated. The engine drone runs continuously during gameplay and the siren can run for an extended period. A mute toggle is the correct path (no prefers-reduced-audio media query exists).

Implementation:
- Small mute button in HUD or main menu, near the existing controls
- Calls audio.setMuted(true|false) — already exported from utils/audio.ts
- aria-pressed state + aria-label='Mute sound effects' / 'Unmute sound effects'
- Persist preference in localStorage (similar to RotateDevicePrompt sessionStorage)
- Touch-friendly target ≥44x44 (WCAG 2.5.5)

Files: components/HUD.tsx (likely), or new components/MuteToggle.tsx component.

Bumped from 'recommended follow-up' to high-priority per a11y-lead caveat that 1.4.2 'user-initiated' helps but doesn't fully exempt the requirement when audio plays >3s.
close_reason: Shipped: components/MuteToggle.tsx — fixed top-right circular button, aria-pressed + aria-label toggle, localStorage persist, immediately stops engine + siren on mute, explicit focus-visible cyan ring (>3:1 contrast), 48x48 target. Verified visually across viewports.

title: Add privacy and abuse controls for shared leaderboard
description: The API accepts arbitrary client-submitted names, emails, scores, and timestamps with open CORS and no auth/rate limit. Before any shared leaderboard rollout, add an approved privacy notice, minimize or remove email collection, add access control/rate limiting, and decide whether scores are informal only or validated server-side.
acceptance_criteria: Leaderboard collection has approved privacy wording, PII minimization, restricted CORS/access, rate limiting or abuse mitigation, and a documented retention/deletion path.

title: Choose IT-hostable deployment and leaderboard architecture
description: Decide the deployment tier for an IT-managed link: internal Docker host behind TLS/SSO/VPN, Cloudflare Tunnel + Access, Azure/App Service or Container Apps with Entra ID, or another agency-approved path. Decide whether leaderboard is localStorage-only, SQLite with mounted volume for pilot, or managed database for production.
acceptance_criteria: Document selected hosting path, data store, auth/access model, backup/retention approach, and operational owner before public/internal rollout.
notes:

title: Reduce per-frame React rendering cost
description: The game currently force-updates React every animation frame, reconciling the map, HUD, minimap, vehicles, and effects. This is likely to cause iPhone jank and battery drain. Move hot rendering to canvas or imperative transforms, keep static map work out of the frame loop, and throttle HUD/minimap React updates.
acceptance_criteria: In-app perf instrumentation shows stable target fps on mobile test devices or graceful 30fps fallback; HUD/minimap updates are throttled; static map does not re-render every frame.
notes:
Scoping pass on feat/mobile-overhaul.

Current state of perf hot paths:
- HUD re-renders are throttled to ~10/sec via setHudTick + HUD_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS (100ms) in components/Game.tsx gameLoop. ✅
- HUD itself is NOT wrapped in React.memo. Memoization wouldn't currently work because:
  - camera prop is constructed as a fresh {x, y} object literal every render — fails shallow-compare every time
  - civilians, districts arrays are mutated in place via civiliansRef.current/districtsRef.current — identity stable, but content changes invisible to memo
  - player object from playerRef.current is mutated in place

Done in commit 6d4d937:
- Gated setDebugInfo on ?debug URL flag (was firing ~2/sec in production for nothing)

Done in commit a24461f (static map cache):
- Built offscreen 3840x2160 canvas containing world background, district grounds, grid pattern, decorations, road kerbs/surfaces, intersection hubs, lane markings.
- Replaced thousands of per-frame canvas operations with a single ctx.drawImage().
- Visual output verified pixel-identical via playwright across iPhone SE/8+/12/14 Pro Max + desktop.
- Measured (headless Chromium, /tmp/perf-baseline.ts, post-game stable state):
  * Desktop 1280x800 short-window: p99 frame time 66.7ms → 19.0ms (3.5x)
  * Desktop fps: 38.3 → 60.0 (rAF-capped, saturated)
  * iPhone SE landscape: 55.3 → 58 fps (modest in headless; expect bigger on real Safari)
  * iPhone 12 landscape: noisy 3s/10s windows, mixed signal — headless software rasterization is not a good predictor for GPU-accelerated Safari which should win bigger
- Memory cost: ~33MB one-time offscreen allocation at game start.

Concrete plan for remaining gd-5k2 work:
1. Restructure HUD to read camera/civilians/districts/dispatchedCall from refs (or a single getState callback) at render time. Drive re-renders explicitly via the existing hudTick prop. This stabilizes prop identity so React.memo works.
2. Wrap HUD with React.memo(). Wrap Minimap with React.memo() with custom areEqual that compares hudTick instead of unstable refs.
3. Add per-frame instrumentation gated on ?debug: rolling avg frame time, React render count for HUD + Minimap, draw time. Surface in the existing debug overlay.
4. Verify on real iPhone (SE → Pro Max) that frame time drops below 16.7ms (60fps) or implement graceful 30fps fallback.

Remaining items 1-3 touch components/Game.tsx (1100 lines) + components/HUD.tsx (444 lines), plus require careful prop-stability work to not break the existing in-place mutation pattern. Recommend a focused session.

Verification tooling:
- /tmp/perf-baseline.ts — playwright frame-time sampler, multi-viewport
- /tmp/iphone-emu-test.ts and /tmp/iphone-overlap-test.ts — visual + ARIA emulation tests
- (Not committed — playwright was added/removed during testing. To re-run: bun add -d playwright && bun /tmp/perf-baseline.ts.)

title: Fix HUD off-screen indicator bounds for variable canvas size
description: Codex /review (2026-05-04) found: HUD camera prop in components/Game.tsx:1078 uses fixed CONSTANTS.VIEWPORT_WIDTH/HEIGHT (1280x720) for the off-screen-indicator bounds, but the canvas now sizes to the container (full viewport). On phones or non-1280x720 desktops, the life-at-risk and dispatch off-screen arrows fire incorrectly: arrows shown when target is on-screen, hidden when off-screen, or positioned outside the visible HUD. Fix: compute camera bounds from the actual canvas/container size at render time instead of CONSTANTS.VIEWPORT_*. Touches Game.tsx HUD render and any HUD off-screen-indicator math that uses VIEWPORT_*.
close_reason: Fixed in commit. HUD off-screen indicators now use actual world-space viewport dimensions instead of fixed CONSTANTS.VIEWPORT_WIDTH/HEIGHT (1280x720). Verified clean typecheck + production build.

value: GeneralDeterrence WCAG 1.4.2 strict reading: even user-initiated audio >3s technically requires a user-controllable mute mechanism. There is NO prefers-reduced-audio media query — mute toggle is the only correct path. Implementation: components/MuteToggle.tsx, fixed top-right at App level (sibling of MainMenu/Game/GameOver/Tutorial), 48x48 button, aria-pressed + aria-label, localStorage 'gd-muted' persistence, on-mute call audio.engineStop+sirenStop+setMuted to halt continuous sounds immediately. Explicit focus-visible:outline-cyan-300 ring (>3:1 contrast against synthwave bg) per 2.4.7/1.4.11.

GeneralDeterrence joystick design (commit 32c2737, components/TouchControls.tsx): role='img' (NOT role='application' which suppresses SR virtual cursor for descendants — too aggressive for a touch-only widget). aria-roledescription='joystick'. aria-label describes how to use. Pointer Events with setPointerCapture so finger tracking continues outside base bounds. touch-action:none on joystick base (vs touch-action:manipulation on action buttons — kills 300ms tap delay). Lifecycle: pointercancel/lostpointercapture release ALL directions (matches Game.tsx visibility/blur/orientationchange handlers). Knob springs back via CSS transition only when not pressed. JOYSTICK_BASE=128, JOYSTICK_KNOB=56, DEADZONE=0.3.

GeneralDeterrence procedural Web Audio (utils/audio.ts, commits b689e3c through a86e3da): zero-asset synthesis. AudioContext lazy on first user gesture (unlockAudio called from button + joystick onPointerDown). Master gain + muted gate. Functions: click(square 900→400Hz 60ms), beep(triangle 1200→1800Hz 200ms), zap(saw 440→2400Hz 270ms), thud(filtered noise 220→80Hz 320ms), tick(triangle pitchHz 60ms — for time pressure), engineStart/setEngineLevel(0..1)/engineStop (saw + lowpass biquad, 80→240Hz, 0.04→0.14 gain, 600→2000Hz cutoff, all linearRamp 100ms), sirenStart/sirenStop (two saw oscs 900/650Hz alternating wail). All continuous sounds (engine, siren) stop on visibilitychange/blur/pagehide/orientationchange via clearHeldInputs AND on gameState transition AND on component unmount.

GeneralDeterrence: testing mobile UI in headless requires playwright with Chrome iPhone device descriptors (devices['iPhone SE'/'iPhone 12'/etc]). Vite browse skill viewport command does NOT trigger touch media features — matchMedia(hover:none, pointer:coarse) returns false. Playwright device-emulation mode IS correct. Test scripts in /tmp (not committed): /tmp/iphone-emu-test.ts, /tmp/iphone-overlap-test.ts, /tmp/perf-baseline.ts. To re-run: bun add -d playwright && bun /tmp/perf-baseline.ts. Real-device hardware testing is still needed since headless software-rasterized canvas does not represent Metal-backed Safari GPU performance.

GeneralDeterrence analog input pattern (commit 1b747b4): joystick emits BOTH boolean direction (forward/back/left/right past 0.3 deadzone, drives existing keysPressed/touchStateRef path) AND analog magnitude via separate analogInputRef. Driving code reads analog and uses Math.abs(x|y) > 0.01 ? |val| : 1.0 — joystick gets gentle/sharp differentiation, keyboard gets full intensity. clearHeldInputs (visibilitychange/blur/pagehide/orientationchange) resets analogInputRef so app-switch with joystick held doesn't leave stale magnitude.

GeneralDeterrence canvas overlap discovery: HUD minimap (top-right) overlaps right-side TouchControls action stack on phones with viewport height between 400 and 500 (e.g., iPhone 8 Plus 414h, 14 Pro Max 430h). The original max-h:400 fix only covered SE landscape (375h). Fix in commit 3f18c1b: widen the bottom-shift breakpoint to max-h:500. Verified with playwright across SE/8+/12/14 Pro Max landscape + portrait — zero overlaps.

GeneralDeterrence HUD memoization pattern (commit bf79ea5): pass hudTick prop, wrap with React.memo((prev,next)=>prev.hudTick===next.hudTick). Other state changes (gameMessage, stationaryCountdown, score, civilians) currently cascade Game→HUD on every setState; with this memo they surface on the next 100ms tick (HUD_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS). HUD's internal effects (score animation, vigilance pulse) still fire on each tick because the function body re-runs. NOTE: any future prop that needs <100ms latency must add itself to the areEqual comparison, OR use internal HUD state instead of a Game prop.

GeneralDeterrence: project tracks package-lock.json (npm) but npm is NOT installed locally. bun and pnpm are available. Adding deps via bun creates bun.lock as untracked — DO NOT commit bun.lock without user direction (creates dual-lockfile divergence). For one-off testing tools (e.g., playwright), install/remove transiently with bun add -d X / bun remove X — node_modules persists during the session, package.json gets reset.
GeneralDeterrence: a11y enforce hook only blocks .tsx UI files. utils/*.ts (e.g. gameRenderer.ts) edits are NOT blocked. Saves a11y-lead delegation overhead for pure rendering/utility code.

GeneralDeterrence iOS Safari viewport pattern: use layered CSS `height: 100vh; height: 100dvh;` (not @supports). Older browsers ignore unknown 100dvh and use 100vh; iOS 15.4+ + modern Chrome/Firefox use 100dvh which adjusts as address bar shows/hides. Helper classes .app-vh / .app-min-vh in index.html style block. dvh fixes 'game pushed off-screen' but does NOT remove browser chrome — for true fullscreen, use Add-to-Home-Screen meta tags.

GeneralDeterrence static map cache (commit a24461f, utils/gameRenderer.ts): the world background, district grounds, grid pattern, decorations, road kerbs/surfaces, intersection hubs, and lane markings are all static once decorations are generated. Cached to a 3840x2160 offscreen HTMLCanvasElement ONCE on first drawGame call, blitted as single drawImage under the same camera transform every frame. Memory: ~33MB. Visual output is pixel-identical (verified across iPhone SE/8+/12/14 Pro Max + desktop). Headless Chromium with software rasterization is NOT a good predictor for real Safari (Metal-backed canvas) — desktop p99 went 66.7→19.0ms in headless tests but real iPhone gains expected to be much bigger. Cache invalidation: never (static data is fixed for the game session).

GeneralDeterrence: vite dev server crashes with ENXIO trying to watch .beads/bd.sock. Fix in vite.config.ts: server.watch.ignored = ['**/.beads/**','**/.dolt/**','**/.gstack/**','**/.serena/**','**/.git/**']. Already shipped in commit 780e7d8.
